paragraphs: The F-Type R575 is an extremely limited-run variant introduced near the end of the F-Type's production life, combining the 5.0-litre supercharged V8 with a 575 PS output — the most powerful non-SVR F-Type ever produced. Under the bonnet sits the AJ133, a Gen III AJ-V8 that's been the backbone of Jaguar's high-performance V8 range for over a decade. It's the same fundamental engine that powered the F-Type R and SVR, though the R575 received a final power bump and some component updates before production ended in 2024. The F-Type R575 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar F-Type R575 Engine Compatibility Because the F-Type R575 uses the AJ133 V8 across its entire production run, the engine itself is consistent — but there were running changes during the X152 generation, including updates to timing chain components and water pump design. Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild. Do you supply used F-Type R575 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my F-Type R575 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an F-Type R575 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most F-Type owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Type R575 from 2023 to present. The AJ133 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
